tasks.label: Export Binaries
command:
Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'bin_files' -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
rmdir /s /q bin_files
mkdir bin_files/bootloader
mkdir bin_files/partition_table
cp build/bootloader/bootloader.bin bin_files/bootloader/
cp build/storage.bin bin_files/
cp build/partition_table/partition-table.bin bin_files/partition_table/
cp  build/${command:espIdf.getProjectName}.bin bin_files/
cp build/ota_data_initial.bin bin_files/
echo '--chip esp32' 'write_flash -z'> bin_files/flash_args.txt
type build/flash_args >> bin_files/flash_args.txt
Remove-Item -LiteralPath '../main-esp32/data/esp32' -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
mkdir ../main-esp32/data/esp32
xcopy bin_files\*.* ..\main-esp32\data\esp32 /s /e /h /i
cp build/bootloader/bootloader.bin ../main-esp32/data/esp32/
cp build/partition_table/partition-table.bin ../main-esp32/data/esp32/partition_table.bin
cp build/${command:espIdf.getProjectName}.bin ../main-esp32/data/esp32/
